eyebrow.zh: 原生时间线 · 智能体可编程 · 零丢失往返

headline.zh:
让 coding agent
直接改你的剪映工程
headline.en:
Let a coding agent
edit your 剪映 project directly

sub.zh: 把剪映原生 .draft 时间线解析成结构化多轨数据，智能体插入字幕、配音、转场后写回——轨道结构零丢失，剪映里重新打开即可继续编辑。
sub.en: Parses 剪映's native .draft timeline into structured multi-track data, lets an agent insert subtitles, voiceovers and transitions, then writes it back — no track structure lost, and it reopens fully editable in 剪映.

title.en: Read your 剪映 timeline as data

body.zh: 一条命令把整个剪映工程打印成可读的多轨树——视频轨、字幕轨、配音轨、转场、特效连同时间戳一目了然。智能体第一次能真正读懂你的剪辑。
body.en: One command prints your whole 剪映 project as a readable multi-track tree — video, subtitle, voiceover, transition and effect tracks with timestamps. An agent can finally understand your edit.

chips: › 视频 · 字幕 · 配音 · 转场 · 特效

title.zh: 智能体直接写回原生轨道
title.en: An agent writes back native tracks

body.zh: 智能体把字幕、配音、转场作为结构化轨道插进时间线，写回后用剪映重新打开——新内容就是原生可编辑的轨道，不是压扁的 MP4。
body.en: An agent inserts subtitles, voiceovers and transitions as structured tracks, then writes them back — reopen in 剪映 and the new content is native, editable track, not a flattened MP4.

chips: › 写回即可在剪映里继续编辑

body.zh: 读出 → 改动 → 写回，剪映重新打开就是同一条原生时间线——轨道、字幕、转场结构原样保留，不再因为导出 MP4 把图层丢光。
body.en: Read → edit → write back, and 剪映 reopens the same native timeline — tracks, subtitles and transitions stay intact, instead of losing every layer to an MP4 export.

chips: › 读出 → 写回 往返无损
› 轨道 · 字幕 · 转场 结构保留

body.zh: 解析、写回、字幕配音转场原语和命令行永久免费，MIT 协议。既能装上就用，也能让智能体直接接进自己的流程。
body.en: Parsing, write-back, the subtitle/voiceover/transition primitives and the CLI are free forever under MIT. Use it from the command line, or let an agent wire it straight into its own workflow.

chips: › MIT · 永久免费 · 命令行 + 库

headline.zh: 别再导出 MP4 重剪了

sub.zh: 装上 draftseam，让你的 coding agent 直接读写剪映原生时间线——字幕、配音、转场写回即可继续编辑。
sub.en: Install draftseam and let your coding agent read and write 剪映's native timeline — subtitles, voiceovers and transitions write back and stay editable.

tag.zh: draftseam — 让 coding agent 直接读写剪映原生 .draft 时间线。MIT 开源。
tag.en: draftseam — let a coding agent read and write 剪映's native .draft timeline. MIT licensed.
